S3. Manipulation checks and descriptive statistics

November 18, 2026
Emma Marshall, J.D., M.A.
University of Nebraska-Lincoln

Notes shared by tables of this section.

  • Tables 1-S3.2 and 1-S3.6: M (SD) over participants with a response; n = responses in the whole primary sample.
  • Tables 1-S3.2, 1-S3.3 and 1-S3.6: Per-condition primary n: Illegal abortion, No information 68; Illegal abortion, Expected evidence 63; Illegal abortion, Unexpected evidence 63; Improper disposal, No information 71; Improper disposal, Expected evidence 66; Improper disposal, Unexpected evidence 67.
  • Tables 1-S3.9 to 1-S3.11: n per condition from the eligibility records of the data preparation.
  • Tables 1-S3.9 to 1-S3.11: Passed, did not pass, and blank come from the recorded checks; a participant who did not pass answered with any other option.
  • Tables 1-S3.9 to 1-S3.11: 95% CI = Wilson score interval for the proportion, without continuity correction.
  • Tables 1-S3.9 to 1-S3.11: Ab = illegal abortion; Di = improper disposal of human remains; expected evidence = evidence consistent with a self-managed abortion; unexpected evidence = financial-crime evidence.
